The caller confirmed her name as Shravani and locality as Madhapur, which the agent confirmed is within the service area. She stated that she did not yet know the refrigerator issue and wanted only a general inspection, then reconfirmed the ₹250 charge and asked to confirm the appointment. The call ended with the agent stating that her details and request to be called again had been recorded, but the transcript does not confirm that the 10:00 AM appointment was actually finalized.
